heuristics: Smoothness probabilities, relation counts and the factor-base size use Dickman's rho with the GS21 alpha correction, as estimated by the GS21 simulator; this is the standard heuristic basis of NFS analyses and is not re-proved here.

The model-to-hardware calibration charges 16 cycle-equivalents per GS21 model operation, 1.41x the worst measured ratio published for this model family (BD19 Table 6, log2(c_sieve) <= 3.5), times the widest current AArch64 scalar retirement width of 8 instructions per cycle; hence 128 instructions per model operation. No measured quantity is extrapolated.

The individual-logarithm descent (BP14: L[1/3,1.44] vs L[1/3,1.923], about 28 bits below the sieving term at p^12 = 2^4572) and ECM cofactorization (about 2^87.6, 38 bits below) are covered by the 1.41x surplus, roughly 2^27 times their estimated cost; GS21 states the descent is very small in comparison with the other two steps.

The retry multiplicity is charged pessimistically as 2 (a single capped attempt assumed to succeed with probability only 1/2), so E[T] <= 2 * single-attempt budget. An expectation appears only here, as the left side of a Markov inequality.

The algorithm is hard-truncated at 2*E[T] instructions and returns FAILURE when the cap is reached, so the submitted work bound is the enforced cap, not an expected value; Markov's inequality gives success probability at least 1/2 over uniform P, uniform z and fresh coins.
The matrix weight (200), filtering factor (20), block-Wiedemann word cost and the sieving arithmetic are GS21's published model constants for BLS-381.
limitations: This is an analytic reproduction of a published cost model at production parameters, not an executed 2^120 computation; the rules allow an analytic argument for exponentially large attacks.

The 2023 BD19-based survey figure 2^122.54 is not used because it is not reproducible from its own stated parameters (its sieving space alone exceeds the reported total); the self-consistent GS21 total is used, which is the larger and therefore conservative choice.
Peak memory 2^72.39 bytes (relation file) is large; it is reported as required but does not enter this track's score.
